name: Gavin Hamilton
milestones: Married Elizabeth Douglas (Hamilton) (m. 20 Jul 1800, Prince George’s County, MD)
sources: Hamilton family register (The Family of Francis Hamilton and Susan), in Bill Allen’s Further Research (February 2012)
notes: Register number 158.2. Died between 5 and 19 January 1814 in Prince George’s County, Maryland; his will left the remainder of his estate to his son Francis Alexander Hamilton.
